metadata.name: Nativism
metadata.period: Contemporary electoral cultural variant; comparative research published 2021–2023
metadata.scope: Electoral cultural nativism prioritising established national culture and inhabitants; not Indigenous sovereignty, hereditary racial nationalism or a universal composite of all nativist movements. Economic and institutional branches remain plural.
metadata.description: A doctrine prioritising established inhabitants and a shared national culture over immigration and external influence. This assessment covers its contemporary electoral cultural variant; economic and social policies vary among proponents.
metadata.phrase: Society should give established inhabitants priority, preserve a shared national culture and control immigration through national institutions, while deciding economic and public affairs according to the national community’s interests.

axes.brief: Electoral cultural nativism seeks native national control through existing competitive politics; that is a scoped variant, not a claim that every nativist is democratic.
